scientific_integrity: The unrestricted signed-holonomy theorem has a self-contained symbolic proof. The finite executable cross-check is corroboration, not an exhaustive proof for arbitrary order. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple tournaments whose actual stable directed one-dimensional color-refinement classes have size at most three; does not treat larger stable cells, arbitrary digraphs, or graph-identifiability among all structures. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Signed matching holonomy and color-refinement orbits in tournaments
